goals: Preserve a player's component-exact organization intent after a physical stack leaves an eligible vanilla storage slot.
Apply the same reservation admission rule to manual placement, vanilla QUICK_MOVE, and vanilla hopper insertion without changing extraction, destination order, or routing policy.
Render empty reservations as an actual approximately 35%-opaque item sprite with a vanilla-positioned literal zero while preserving the occupied marker and empty-reservation hover tooltip.

Overlay the same reservation visuals on the exact 27 physical slots of supported Easy Shulker Boxes and Item Interactions vanilla-shulker tooltips without changing contents, calculations, selection, interaction, or server behavior.

Keep reservation persistence, synchronization, user actions, and insertion server-authoritative while exposing defensive classification and reservation queries without becoming an item-routing engine.
scope: Maintain exact Minecraft Java 26.2 Fabric Canary 2 from implementation and artifact checkpoint 48468ad99ba1353ac5455be39dedef6ca143f7ae while preserving accepted Canary 1 as rollback.

Store sparse format-1 reservations as immutable count-one ItemStackTemplate values in a persistent, network-synchronized project component; item identity remains exactly component-aware while count is excluded.
Support exact vanilla chest, trapped-chest, barrel, undyed shulker, and all 16 dyed shulker owners, with double-chest logical slots resolved to the owning physical half and local slot 0 through 26.

Preserve Canary 1 occupied, cursor-derived, replacement, clear, removal-retains-intent, shulker item round-trip, persistence, networking, request validation, manual insertion, vanilla QUICK_MOVE, hopper behavior, and public defensive query/classification behavior.

Render an empty reservation with its exact count-one template sprite using premultiplied alpha 0x59, followed by a shadowed literal zero at vanilla's stack-count position; render no empty-slot wash or outline and retain the compact occupied marker.

Use client-only string-targeted pseudo mixins at the exact audited Item Interactions 26.2.2 tooltip factory, component, and physical-slot rendering seams; activate only when Easy Shulker Boxes and Item Interactions are both present and the supported shulker has reservations.
Validate against exact Easy Shulker Boxes 26.2.3 and its nested Item Interactions 26.2.2 artifact bytes while keeping both runtime metadata predicates flexible and optional.

exclusions: Copper chests, arbitrary modded containers, player inventory, equipment, crafting and result slots, trinket slots, trash slots, fake slots, and foreign menu slots.
Automatic sorting, item routing, destination selection, routing priority, dump-all behavior, restock quantities, cross-container templates, category or tag matching, and multiple identities per slot.
Changes to vanilla extraction, ordinary chest or barrel drop metadata, unsupported container ownership, or vanilla QUICK_MOVE and hopper ordering beyond reservation admission.

Fake zero-count stacks, mutation of DataComponents.CONTAINER, reservation-aware Easy Shulker Boxes insertion or extraction controls, or changes to tooltip fullness, dimensions, selection, scrolling, collapsing, highlighting, colors, names, storage bars, or mouse interactions.

Hard runtime dependencies or restrictive upper bounds for Easy Shulker Boxes or Item Interactions, direct modification or redistribution of either upstream artifact, or optional-class linkage outside safely gated client mixins.

Changes to another Workbench project, shared Test Instance Manager state, either runtime slot, the dedicated Workbench deployment, or the protected gameplay profile during this predeployment checkpoint.
Minecraft client launch, inferred runtime evidence, successor acceptance or promotion, or mutation of the exact accepted Canary 1 artifact and provenance.
